posts.title: AI Brief — Thursday, 5 November 2026
posts.summary: Open-weights day — Moonshot dropped the Kimi K3.1 Pro weights (2.8T MoE, 1M context), Ricursive's dense Ripple-65B claims the US open-weight lead on agentic coding and Tencent shipped Hy4 with weights promised "in the coming days", while Anthropic showed you can cryptographically prove which model produced an answer.

posts.title: AI Brief — Friday, 6 November 2026
posts.summary: Security and open weights dominate: OpenAI's agent pipeline wrote 948 working Linux-kernel root exploits (and patches) for $1.2M and GPT-6-Cyber hit the API, Thinking Machines unveiled Inkling 2 Small with Apache-2.0 weights promised next week, llama.cpp shipped v0.9.0 with FP8, and two papers argue agents don't need long context or extra turns as much as you think.

posts.title: AI Brief — Saturday, 7 November 2026
posts.summary: A quieter Saturday led by METR's independent finding that AI is roughly doubling Anthropic's R&D pace, Google's Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash video model going GA, Baidu open-sourcing the ERNIE 5.5 Flash base model, and two agent papers showing 40–90% of tokens can be cut without hurting results.
